mode: Read-only source review; no provider or database writes, no per-case extractor outputs inspected
result: Preview evidence is not durable coffee enrichment. New-record Add stores supported form fields; exact verified reuse does not store newly extracted canonical values either.

findings.description: source_facts, roaster_details, and published roaster_recipe are displayed in the preview. Only the ten canonical fields have form controls and are copied by applyCoffeeUrlFields. The controller keeps the matched input URL, not the complete preview object. Add constructs its payload from FormData, so supplementary evidence and recipes do not enter proposed_data.

evidence.detail: Ten-field allowlist; supplementary disclosure; explicit not-saved copy; field-only application loop
New Coffee controls, transient found object, FormData-based submit
proposalWithRecognizedRoaster forwards only submitted form facts

findings.description: When identity matches an existing verified coffee, Add sends only the existing coffee ID and personal library-entry ID. A newly extracted variety or other canonical value missing from that existing record is not persisted. The server's independent exact-match branch also only creates or reuses the personal link. This can make successful preview extraction appear lost after Add.

evidence.detail: chosenId branch calls add_verified_coffee with IDs only
Exact verified reuse only changes library membership

findings.preserved_policy: Do not silently overwrite verified canonical records or bypass identity/release confirmation. Fresh evidence can support a separate reviewed correction, not an implicit canonical mutation.

findings.description: The canonical coffee table includes summary, espresso_notes and roaster_recipe, but not source_facts or roaster_details. The current Add path does not populate even the existing recipe column from preview. Source provenance rows store independently verified field_values or an empty object for a merely member-supplied URL; they are not a private generic preview archive. Hydration does not expose source_facts/roaster_details.

evidence.detail: Explicit canonical insert columns and verified-only source field_values
Hydrates supported canonical fields and optional stored recipe, no supplementary evidence

findings.description: Passing the entire source-fact preview through proposed_data would be unsafe as a minimal fix. Preview evidence is bounded at 128 items / 64000 characters, while the existing mutation and submission limits are 32000 bytes. UTF-8 byte length and JSON overhead matter. Increasing those limits or silently clipping all extra evidence would change the existing contract.

evidence.detail: Published source fact count and character bounds

recommendation.immediate_without_new_services_or_api_ke: Offer an explicit client-side Copy/Download source-review snapshot containing source URL, capture time, canonical suggestions, supplementary facts, conflicts, recipe and truncation status. A browser Blob/text download needs no API key, external service, provider write or additional fetch. Keep the existing truthful preview-only wording. Do not describe a download as cross-device persistence.
recommendation.verified_reuse: Keep verified reuse safe, but expose freshly found differences and route an intentional correction through the existing reviewed correction flow. Do not silently replace shared canonical values, and do not claim all newly previewed fields were added to the existing record.
recommendation.durable_option_requiring_product_contrac: A future explicit source-snapshot feature should store bounded, unverified, URL/release-bound evidence separately for the member's library entry, with capture timestamp, source digest, conflict markers and truncation state. It should survive approved-record reuse, remain distinct from shared verified facts, and be viewable after Add. Define byte limits, retention/version policy and privacy before implementing storage. Existing infrastructure can be used without a new AI service or API key; this review does not assert that arbitrary storage growth has zero cost.
do_not_do: Do not copy preview evidence into canonical fields or official coffee_sources merely because Add was clicked.
Do not append 64 KB of raw evidence to an existing 32 KB mutation and rely on silent truncation.
Do not auto-apply a published espresso reference to the member's saved recipe or learning priors.
Do not introduce browser/OCR/model execution into the paid runtime as a persistence workaround.

limitations: Static current-worktree review, not a hosted database or production behavior test.
No implementation, schema change, migration, storage policy or publication authorized by this read-only review was performed.
The locked independent source oracles remain unchanged.
